custom_protocol.registration_timing: Before homology-map inspection and before any model run; after original task registration. NOT claimed as prior-to-task-selection preregistration.
custom_protocol.input_identity: Reuse prior full-file QC exact raw-string SHA256 keys with source-file binding; no U/T conversion or case folding
group_policy: Always union identical exact gene annotations, including genes missing from HomoloGene
Union every known HomoloGene group; multi-group gene annotation bridges conservatively rather than silently taking last row
Union identical exact whole-input hashes across gene groups
custom_protocol.assignment: Sort connected components by descending size, then SHA256(seed + group row IDs). Assign each to split with largest unfilled target row deficit; fixed train/validation/test tiebreak. No label values used.
custom_protocol.homology_scope: Known source groups only; no independent sequence-homology clearance claim
